name: Macro Metals Limited
summary: Macro Metals Limited and its associated entities discover and assess mineral deposits, mostly iron ore, in Australia and Nigeria. It fully owns an iron ore and steel project, Agbaja, in Nigeria's Kogi State, has a stake in the Mogul VMS project in Western Australia, and manages eight iron ore ventures in the Pilbara and Mid West. It dates from 1980 and is based in Peppermint Grove.
